verdict.rationale: Stripe documents push-based events tied to agentic orders — `checkout.session.completed` fires per completed order with agent attribution, and separate webhooks exist for catalog import status and SPT token state transitions (issued/used/revoked) — plus checkout session statuses (incomplete/ready_for_payment/processing/completed/canceled) and a `delegated_checkout.requested_session.completed` webhook for embedded flows. However, there is no explicit documentation of a unified 'order lifecycle' webhook set covering created/updated/fulfilled/canceled as distinct pushed events; fulfillment is described as a bulk pull via the List CheckoutSessions API rather than a push event. Missing for 10: explicit webhook events for order 'updated', 'fulfilled', and 'canceled' beyond checkout-session completion, and independent/hands-on confirmation of subscribing to these events end-to-end.
